req.title: Retrieve all players
req.statement: The system shall respond to GET /players with a JSON array of all players in the database.

doc.reasoning: The test suite is designed to validate the functionality of the GET /players/ endpoint, ensuring it returns the correct data and handles errors appropriately. The tests cover positive, negative, and boundary cases to ensure robustness against common mutations.

tests.name: test_retrieve_all_players_positive
expected: Response contains a JSON array with 26 Player objects.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)
response = client.get('/players/')
assert response.status_code == 200
players = response.json()
assert isinstance(players, list)
assert len(players) == 26
assert players[0]['firstName'] == 'Franco'
assert players[0]['squadNumber'] == 1

tests.name: test_retrieve_all_players_negative
actions: Send a GET request to an invalid endpoint /players/invalid.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)
response = client.get('/players/invalid')
assert response.status_code == 404

tests.name: test_retrieve_all_players_boundary
expected: Response contains a JSON array with exactly 26 Player objects.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)
response = client.get('/players/')
assert response.status_code == 200
players = response.json()
assert isinstance(players, list)
assert len(players) == 26
assert players[-1]['firstName'] == 'Nahuel'
assert players[-1]['squadNumber'] == 26
